Donald Trump

assigns only a 17% chance that the U.S. ends the naval blockade of Iran by Sept. 30, down from 80% a month ago.
Similarly, the probability of the blockade ending by Oct. 31 fell from 87% to 36%, while the chance of resolution by year-end 2026 dropped from 90% to 60%.
The probability of a final nuclear deal between the two countries also stayed low, at 3% by Oct. 31 and 11% by the end of the year.
